tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Search Geppetto's directory of 300+ robots by category, brand, price range, or use case. Returns robot name, slug, category, brand, price range, and key specs.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term, category, or use case. Examples: humanoid, robot vacuum, lawn mower, cobot

params.name: category
params.description: Robot category slug. Options: humanoid, cleaning, lawn, aerial, medical, security, agricultural, delivery, industrial, companion, educational, inspection

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Get full specs and details for a specific robot by its slug. Returns all specifications, price, brand, description, features, and direct URL.

params.name: slug
params.description: Robot slug e.g. agility-robotics-digit, roborock-s8-maxv-ultra, boston-dynamics-spot

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Compare two robots side by side on specs, price, and capabilities. Returns a comparison URL and key differences.

tools.name: get_job_automation_risk
tools.description: Get the Geppetto automation risk score (0-100) for any profession. Higher score means robots are actively displacing this role at commercial scale right now. Includes IFR deployment data, Oxford automation score, and McKinsey task automation rate.

params.name: profession_slug
params.description: Profession slug e.g. warehouse-picker-packer, delivery-driver-last-mile, registered-nurse, long-haul-truck-driver

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Get all robots in a specific category with specs and prices. Returns the full list of active robots in that category from the Geppetto directory.

params.name: category_slug
params.description: Category slug e.g. humanoid, cleaning, lawn, aerial, medical, security, agricultural, delivery, industrial, companion, educational, inspection
